selected_candidate.rust_preference: Keep own Rust domain semantics, alias/source-map AST lowering, dependency graph, deterministic Date/random/time profile, resource accounting, typed diagnostics and immutable evaluation ports. A mature JS runtime is an optional syntax/execution implementation; building a second JS translator/interpreter without semantic evidence increases compatibility work. Pure-Rust Boa remains a candidate if equivalent enforceable quota, deadline, reclamation and compatibility contracts are independently proven.

required_controls.contract: Pin all wrapper/core/sys versions, packaged checksums and bundled QuickJS-NG source identity, feature graph, target/compiler flags and any patches. Engine/profile/ABI/schema/host-semantics identities bind compiled artifacts and replay receipts; moving docs do not replace exact source.

Use explicit nonzero JS heap and stack limits before user parsing/compilation/evaluation, with accepted-value readback and fail-closed configuration. A wrapper setting that maps an oversized stack value to0/unlimited is rejected by provider configuration; supported target stack behavior must be proven separately.

Do not publish categorical custom-allocator memory-limit behavior from contradictory docs. Default candidate excludes allocator/rust-alloc until the exact allocator path is independently tested. VM-accounted heap is distinct from allocator arena/Rust snapshots, compiled cache, result conversion and worker RSS; all remain aggregate-admitted and charged until actual reclamation.

Interrupt is cooperative engine polling, not exact deterministic fuel or guaranteed wall deadline. One semantic allowance covers nested reads/retries/AST checkpoints, callbacks and frame/composition work. Parsing, long C builtins and foreign Rust callbacks need independent worker deadline/termination containment; bounded host callbacks check cancellation and charge before work. No callback deadline assertion substitutes for external bounded failure proof.

No user dynamic compilation through eval, Function, constructor chains, prototypes, accessors, proxies or host callback objects. Base/custom context construction alone does not prove this: base objects include Function and Eval intrinsic enables shared compiler state. Choose and prove a trusted compile/evaluation realm or explicit parser/runtime restriction preserving required syntax; global-name deletion alone is insufficient. No user-supplied serialized bytecode.

Admitted deterministic language profile is enforced on AST and reachable intrinsics, not merely described. Deny async/promise/jobs/modules/loader/native libc APIs/ambient Date/random/locale and unsupported syntax before activation; versioned host Date/random/property functions and both declared aliases retain exact normative signatures. Preserve unsupported original bytes with source-position diagnostics and disabled/error receipt, never silently activate or bake.

Each evaluation has a clean realm and explicit immutable revision/sample/seed/profile inputs. Runtime/context/JS values never cross incompatible runtimes or worker ownership. Shared compiled-cache bytes and count are capped; live contexts retained by cached values remain charged. Runtime/contexts/closures/values and native finalizers retire on correct owner with bounded reclamation before capacity release.

Concurrency is separate runtimes behind bounded worker admission, not concurrent access to one unsafe VM. Send/Sync wrapper features are facade locking guarantees with required stack-top/thread transitions, not realtime safety or foreign-pointer portability. Prefer synchronous single-owner worker profile; no async jobs/futures or background free queue in the initial deterministic expression profile.

Host property reads use explicit revision-bound opaque resources and shared dependency/operation allowance. AST rewriting preserves evaluation order/local bindings/computed member semantics and source maps; dynamic reads stage and validate graph before activation. Effect's loop cap, reusable thread-local runtime, host-miss replay and text rewrite are references requiring adaptation, not production isolation/replay proof.

Result conversion cannot execute unbounded user getters/proxies/coercion or allocate unchecked output. Restrict output value shapes/property types, bound conversion nodes/depth/bytes and charge every host copy; failure never promotes partial output. Timeouts and interruption invalidate incomplete evaluation and produce typed dimension/source trace plus explicit underlying-value fallback/error render receipt.

Actual supported Windows/macOS x64/ARM targets require pinned compile/link/package and runtime proofs. Source bindings or build branches establish intention only; no host matrix PASS from presence. Unsupported toolchain/target/stack/isolation returns explicit unavailable, never an unbounded fallback or silently different engine/profile.

Provider foundation exposes executable minimal compile/evaluate/cancel/reclaim/diagnostic operations before domain features; root updates approved module/barrier/dependency and exact MT ownership without altering prior lineage. Asset-local proof is separate from actual Handshake sandbox/authorization/PromotionGate/manual/Argus integration. No provider creates a catalog/scheduler/database or writes authority.

The production JavaScript AST/parser/lowering/checkpoint-instrumentation owner is NOT_ESTABLISHED by rquickjs or Effect source. Name and implement that owner as an executable prerequisite; ordinary engine interrupt polls are not semantic AST fuel. Instrument every admitted control-flow and function/callback entry, preserve evaluation order and source maps, and charge nested reads, retries and result conversion to the same immutable job allowance. Activation fails when a syntax path lacks proved instrumentation.

Cached executable identity MUST include canonical source digest, parser/AST-lowering/checkpoint/source-map versions, deterministic profile and host API semantics, exact wrapper plus bundled C/build-feature/patch/target/endianness identity. Only trusted compiler-produced artifacts may enter unsafe bytecode decode; matching engine format version/checksum alone is insufficient. Cache mismatch recompiles preserved source or fails unavailable, never adopts supplied executable bytes.

findings.quote: Every planned platform and Studio foundation MUST expose its executable minimum before domain features begin
findings.finding: Unqualified platform-foundation plus actual-production proof wording can gate all pure asset domain development on the unfinished shared host lifecycle, contrary to explicit operator phase scope and STU-ARC-006.
findings.correction: Require executable portable platform/provider adapter minima with bounded supported/unsupported consumer paths in the asset foundation barrier. Real shared host install/consent/activate/revoke/lifecycle and production authorization/sandbox/state/Argus/UserManual proof are hard predecessors for actual plugin activation and corresponding host embedding, not unrelated pure asset feature development. HSK-PLG-001 missing lifecycle remains real and is not waived.

findings.quote: Use clean realms across trust boundaries
findings.finding: This names account/resource isolation but does not explicitly prevent same-document repeated evaluations from carrying mutated prototypes/global/closure/host state across ticks. MOT076 separately forbids evaluation-order dependence, so explicit provider control is required.
findings.correction: Require fresh evaluation state for each independent sample/evaluation or independently proven complete reset isolating all mutable globals/prototypes/closures/host memoization. Immutable trusted compiled artifacts may be reused; retries share allowance and exact immutable inputs. Same-document/same-account reversed frame order and fresh-versus-reused worker must conform, not merely cross-account tests.

findings.finding: Acceptance is ambiguous beside CON014 selection/proposal/rejection events which expressly do not claim document promotion. A consumer can require PromotionDecision Accepted and omit proposal/rejection audit events, or emit undurable view telemetry as accepted business authority.
findings.correction: Define the boundary by event class: accepted document mutations mirror only after canonical promotion/event transaction; proposal/rejection/view audit business events mirror only after their own canonical typed record/event is durably accepted, without implying document promotion. Transient uncommitted previews remain distinct bounded diagnostics; same durable mirror-intent/retry/collision controls apply to all required business rows.
